name: Search

props.note: Same name and default. Hidden unless showLabel is on.
Figma value is sample text for the filled state.
Starting query. Figma has no controlled / uncontrolled split.
Behaviour. The filled state draws the clear button.
A value of the state axis in Figma. The spinner replaces the search icon, as in code.
disabled=true in code is state=disabled in Figma.
Web only. Accessible name of the search landmark.
Figma-only axis for specs and prototypes. focus is :focus-visible. disabled comes from the disabled prop.

purpose: Search input wrapped in a search landmark with a leading icon, clear button, Escape-to-clear, and an optional loading spinner.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label (visually hidden unless showLabel). Make it specific: 'Search players'.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called on every change (debounce in your code for remote search).

props.name: onClear
props.description: Called when cleared via button or Escape.

props.name: loading
props.description: Swap the search icon for a spinner.

props.name: landmarkLabel
props.description: Names the role=search landmark when a page has more than one.

accessibility.role: search landmark (<form role=search>) containing a searchbox (<input type=search>)

keyboard.action: Clear the query (keeps focus in the field).
Moves to the clear button when visible.

screenReader: Landmark navigation finds the search region.
Clear button announced as 'Clear search, button'.
Announce result counts in a polite live region in your results area ('12 players found').
accessibility.focus: Focus ring on the control; focus returns to the input after clearing.
accessibility.touchTarget: 44px control and clear button on touch.

variants.name: instant
variants.description: Filter as you type with onValueChange.

do: Give the label a specific scope ('Search products').
Announce result counts with a live region.
dont: Don't use Search for non-search text entry; use InputField.
Don't move focus away from the input as results update.

related.name: Tag
related.reason: Show active filters as removable tags.

example.web: {results.length} players found
